environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (not block), (2) a custom rule group 'org-sqli-body-check' that inspects ONLY the request body for SQL patterns using a regex pattern set, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with default action BLOCK applied to ALL request components (URI path, query string, headers, body) at priority 30. The ECS task role has a permissions boundary policy that denies iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, and all S3 actions. The task runs in a private subnet with egress only through a NAT gateway. CloudWatch Logs captures all WAF sampled requests.

waf_rules.name: org-sqli-body-check
waf_rules.note: Custom regex rule group - inspects request body only

config.network: Private subnet, egress via NAT GW only
config.logging: CloudWatch Logs with WAF sampled requests
